value: Eliezer S. Yudkowsky is an American artificial intelligence researcher and writer, best known for his work on AI safety and popularizing the concept of friendly artificial intelligence. As the founder of the Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI), he primarily focuses on mitigating the catastrophic risks associated with a potential runaway intelligence explosion, advocating for the design of AI systems with inherent safe behaviors. Yudkowsky has controversially called for a global moratorium on AI development, even suggesting military action to enforce it. Additionally, he is a prominent figure in the rationality movement, having founded the influential LessWrong blog and authored numerous works on decision theory and ethics.
